verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Statsig serves an official llms.txt at docs.statsig.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled 'Statsig Documentation'). Multiple doc excerpts sourced from that file show it indexes pages on gates, dynamic configs, experiments, Autotune and monitoring with agent-friendly descriptions, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md probe returned 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
